description: Use this when the user asks about one to three Fantasy Premier League players: 'how many points will Saka get?', 'is Palmer worth buying?', 'Saka or Palmer?', 'is Isak fit?'. Gives our model's predicted points for the next gameweek with where they come from (minutes, goals, assists, clean sheet, bonus, defensive contributions), his chance of playing, news, fixtures, price and ownership. With 2-3 names, compares them on next gameweek. Pass all the names in one call.

players.description: 1-3 player names (e.g. 'Saka', 'Gabriel ARS') or FPL player ids, all in this one call: for 'Saka or Palmer?' pass ['Saka', 'Palmer'].

name: player_projection
title: FPL player points
